notes: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B_q4_block32_ekv4096.litertlm as uploaded to litert-community/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B on 2026-10-06 (Hub commit 1c9be2ef): graph rewrite of the previous Hub file (KV-cache writes -> odml.cache_update, attention products -> odml.runtime_bmm, param_tensor input, broadcast mask add) plus one copied 16-token prefill signature; the weights are byte-identical to the previous file (sha256 511d59c11704...), which this upload replaced. Built and measured by the litertlm-convert GPU graph re-ship lane (rounds 1-21). Mac gate of this file (round 19, litertlm-convert gpu_reship_work/results/ship_verify): 6/6 points — weights and every other section byte-identical to the previous file, tflite CPU outputs bit-identical, litert-lm CPU answers 9/9 byte-identical, GPU (WebGPU) fully delegated with fp32 activations 9/9 byte-identical; GPU fp16 (the default) final answers 8/8 against 8/8 without the 16-token signature. Galaxy S26 GPU gate (round 16, Session path, greedy): 4/4 questions, long prompt missed, the same points as the file without the 16-token signature on the same phone. Previous file on the same Mac in the same lock window (litert-lm 0.17.1, same flags): gpu p256 d256: decode 65.0 tok/s, prefill 643.78 tok/s, TTFT 0.418 s; gpu p16 d32: decode 62.88 tok/s, prefill 80.3 tok/s, TTFT 0.2198 s; cpu p256 d256: decode 18.15 tok/s, prefill 64.71 tok/s, TTFT 4.8685 s; cpu p16 d32: decode 12.09 tok/s, prefill 8.14 tok/s, TTFT 2.8925 s. Galaxy S26 rows: Google's prebuilt litert_lm_advanced_main (sha256 adac974b...) and libLiteRtOpenClAccelerator.so (d9dd64c3...) fetched on 2026-10-04 from storage.googleapis.com/litert/binaries/latest/android_arm64/litert_lm/ (object last-modified 2026-09-18; the binary carries the string 0.18.0 and prints no version line; LiteRT-LM main that day = 56c67f7d, the binary's own commit unconfirmed), so the snapshot axis is the digest token prebuilt-adac974b until the owner names it (DECISIONS #174(2)). Each figure is the median of the iterations of one process; per-iteration values are in metrics (iteration 1 starts cold at the full clock ceiling, later ones run under the phone's own thermal cap).
quantization: int4 weights - blockwise (block 32) + OCTAV optimal-clipping, symmetric; embedding INT8
